intro: Kiribati is a presidential republic, independent since 1979.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president, called the Beretitenti, is elected by voters from candidates nominated by parliament. Taneti Maamau has been president since 2016.

chapters.title: Ties with China
text: Kiribati switched recognition from Taiwan to China in 2019.
